LanguageData.PF_CelestialHypoxia.label: hypoxia
LanguageData.PF_CelestialHypoxia.description: Insufficient oxygen partial pressure. Oxygen supply is required; toxin resistance does not supply oxygen.
LanguageData.PF_CelestialPressureStress.label: pressure stress
LanguageData.PF_CelestialPressureStress.description: Pressure beyond the adapted range. Vacuum protection covers low pressure only; high pressure requires separate protection.
LanguageData.PF_CelestialRadiationExposure.label: environmental radiation exposure
LanguageData.PF_CelestialRadiationExposure.descriptio: A simplified accumulation of planetary radiation damage. Dedicated radiation protection is required; oxygen and toxin filtering do not block radiation.
